reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is about $1.00 a day, and my Nature Made 200 mg is around $0.39 a day. I already have a magnesium that works for me, and a new brand with zero reviews doesn't give me a reason to pay almost 3x.
objection: A dollar a day when I pay 39 cents for the same 200 mg, from a brand with no reviews. The lab QR code is a nice touch but I can't tell yet whether it justifies the gap.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews from people who sleep better on it, plus a lower price per serving (closer to $0.60 a day), or a cheap trial box so I can test it first.
